planets.name: HAT-P-29 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Muspelheim with a 5.72-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: HAT-P-29 b was found in 2011 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Muspelheim. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
